sections.signoff: From the desk of a professional party girl.
sections.credentials: Former editor of Concrete Playground Australia, Time Out Melbourne and Halliday Wine Companion.

sections.heading: Eliza Campbell
paragraphs: As Concrete Playground's former Managing Editor (and former editor of *Halliday Wine Companion* and *Time Out Melbourne*), I know a thing or two about what's worth eating, drinking and doing in Australia. As a perpetually over-committed party girl who has never once missed a 6am hot pilates class, I'm hard to impress – but never snobby.

From the coldest vodka martini in town to the live music gigs you should be buying tickets to, I'm the friend whose recommendations you don't second-guess. Irreverent, dry and reliably the one in the room saying "it's PR, not ER" when everyone else is deeping it, I take the wine list (but not life) very seriously.
